title: Lead pages and Help say Lead, and decisions and Needs you read in the owner's words at 390 and 1280 px
description: A real browser on the built dashboard over the demo data at 390 and 1280 px checks the five Lead/Settings wording fixes from docs/ux-findings.md: Lead Product says 'Updated Nov 13 by the Lead.', Lead Decision cards fold agent-wording Why details by default, Settings Help calls the planner the Lead (including inside every FAQ fold and Common commands), Settings Setup reports an un-onboarded repo without 'Master fault', and Settings Needs you opens with a single plain sentence. None of the five views scrolls sideways.

steps.name: the five Lead and Settings wording fixes hold at 390 and 1280 px
